scope: Additive Royal Champion Frost Flake L1-27 target, freeze, damage and projectile audit.
game_version: December 2025 Equipment launch and September 2026 inventory; dated secondary claimed client build 18.600.3; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: About Heroes & Pets
facts: Frost Flake is listed among Royal Champion Epic Equipment in the permanent Hero Journey inventory.
sources.limitations: No projectile, target or freeze timing values are given.

sources.title: Meltdown Mayhem Event
facts: Frost Flake was introduced as Epic Royal Champion Equipment in the December 2025 medal event.
sources.limitations: Event acquisition is temporary; the page does not define fixed-tick combat mechanics.

sources.title: Frost Flake
facts: On activation, flakes go simultaneously to nearby defenses, deal damage and freeze on impact.
When defenses are insufficient, other buildings and defending troops may be targeted; air units can be hit; each target receives at most one flake.
sources.limitations: No deterministic distance metric, fallback order, tie-break, projectile speed, hitbox or fixed-tick freeze transition is specified.

sources.title: Frost Flake — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: Dated table matches pinned Champion HP bonus 50-700 and ore costs.
sources.limitations: It does not publish current projectile damage, freeze duration, target count or freeze strength.

sources.title: Pinned Frost Flake Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: Pinned 100% slowdown label, 105-294 projectile damage, 5.2-7 seconds duration and 4-7 target count.
sources.limitations: The payload does not specify current continuity, projectile timing, target tie-break, freeze interaction or slow stacking.

derivations.result: Retain pinned projectile, duration, count and slow labels as catalogue provenance; current dated source confirms only HP and costs
derivations.method: Compare pinned level series, permanent official inventory, dated release and community qualitative behavior without inventing a target metric or tick schedule.

rejected_inferences.rule: Freeze exactly the nearest 4-7 defenses by center distance with entity-ID ties
rejected_inferences.reason: Target geometry, eligibility, fallback order and tie-break are not specified by the sources.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat 100% slowdown as suppressing all attacks and movement for exactly 5.2-7 seconds from activation
rejected_inferences.reason: The label does not specify affected channels, impact delay, expiry phase or stacking with other slows.

rejected_inferences.rule: Damage and freeze every target at activation before projectile travel
rejected_inferences.reason: The community description says impact, but projectile speed and simultaneous impact order are unknown.

rejected_inferences.rule: Include the temporary Meltdown Mayhem event content in battle
rejected_inferences.reason: The permanent Equipment is in scope; event resources and event mechanics are not.

items: current projectile damage, freeze duration, target count and slowdown continuity
defense priority, fallback classes, geometry, target tie-break and air eligibility
projectile launch, travel, impact and concurrent hit tick order
freeze effect on movement and attack, expiration and stacking
damage stage, Wall and trap interaction, Hero and Pet effects
Viewer flake rendering, snapshot, replay and RL loadout state

conclusion: Frost Flake L1-27 remains partial and catalogue-only. Permanent Royal Champion inventory and community reports support the freeze-projectile concept, while pinned data records damage, duration, slowdown and target-count labels. Current effect values and deterministic targeting, projectile and freeze contracts remain unresolved. No Equipment Core actor is enabled.
